Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Location: Bucharest, Romania
 About
 Our client provides practical solutions related to Data and AI, Cloud Services, Robotics and digital Engineering and Business Process Management to their clients.
 ROLE
 Our client is seeking an experienced SAP Application Support Consultant with knowledge of SAP SD, MM, and/or EWM to support enterprise supply chain systems.
The successful candidate will ensure the stability and reliability of SAP applications, manage incidents, troubleshoot functional issues, and collaborate with business and IT teams to improve processes across sales, procurement, warehousing, and logistics.
 Responsibilities
 Provide daily SAP application support, system monitoring, and maintenance.
 Investigate and resolve incidents reported by business users, identifying root causes and implementing appropriate solutions.
 Monitor SAP system performance and participate in operational improvement initiatives.
 Collaborate with supply chain teams to understand operational challenges in sales, purchasing, warehouse management, and logistics.
 Identify opportunities to improve business processes and system functionalities.
 Coordinate with technical teams to investigate cross-system and cross-module issues.
 Support continuous optimization of SAP applications and related processes.
 Maintain technical documentation, incident records, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge bases.
 Participate in cross-functional and international collaboration to ensure efficient issue resolution.
 Requirements
 Minimum 2 years of experience in SAP application support or implementation.
 Hands-on experience with at least one of the following SAP modules:
 SAP SD (Sales and Distribution)
 SAP MM (Materials Management)
 SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)
 Good understanding of supply chain business processes and operational workflows.
 Experience investigating SAP incidents and troubleshooting application issues.
 Ability to independently analyse and resolve common functional problems.
 Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
 Ability to collaborate with business users, IT professionals, and technical specialists.
 Proactive attitude, adaptability, and willingness to learn new SAP functionalities.
 Professional English proficiency, both written and spoken.
 PREFFERED
 Hands-on experience across multiple SAP modules, particularly SD, MM, and EWM.
 Previous experience in SAP application maintenance and production support.
 Experience supporting SAP systems within manufacturing environments.
 Knowledge of cross-module integration and supply chain optimization.
